versions.changelog: Security hardening: remove all repository/package validators and release tooling from the installable skill; retain only the explicitly requested single-report HTML renderer. Declare bounded file/tool access, narrow personal-life triggers, add privacy minimization and host-retention guidance, and explain language choice and the optional Chinese HTML layout. Protect existing outputs and reject input/output file aliases. Verified report structure, file-access scope, HTML escaping, and a 42-file allowlisted package.
Change the catalog display name to Chinese while preserving the existing slug, install path, and source repository.
Improve user-facing language, strengthen report-content gates, add deterministic clean packaging, and remove Git metadata from upload artifacts.
README wording update: refine public-facing usage instructions and remove maintainer-oriented publishing notes.
Initial release: life fork grammar, archetype matching, event shock cards, HTML-first report templates, and validation scripts.
